theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_total_bounded
theorems.statement: ((∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) ∧ T.support = U ∩ R.measure.support) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U (n + 1)) (RT : IMRep U (n + 1)) (RB : IMRep U n) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (L : NNReal), IsOpen U → RT.Represents T → RB.Represents T.boundary → LipschitzWith L f → ∃ Ps : ℝ → GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → AEMeasurable (fun t => (Ps t).massOn W) ∧ ∫⁻ t, (Ps t).massOn W ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) * T.massOn W) ∧ ∀ᵐ t, IsIntegerMultiplicity (Ps t) ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) (f ⁻¹' {t}) → Ps t ω = 0) ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, Ps t ω = (∫ x in RT.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RT.mult x : ℝ) * RT.orient x (exteriorDerivative (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n + 1]) - ∫ x in RB.carrier ∩ {x | f x < t}, (RB.mult x : ℝ) * RB.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μHE[n]) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ ε : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → Λ ≠ ∞ → 0 < ε → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity A.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) K → A ω = 0) → A.mass ≤ Λ → A.boundary.mass ≤ Λ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), A ω - Q ω = R.boundary ω + S ω) ∧ R.mass + S.mass < ε
